content:
Alex: Heads-up — planning a small deploy window tonight 22:00 UTC to push kernel v2.14 + new quant profile 'q-lite-8'. Who can own the slot?
Cheng: I can own the deploy + smoke. I'll be on-call from 21:30 UTC and online from 21:45.
Marie: I'll monitor telemetry, tracing, and perf dashboards. Can run the sample generation smoke and check p95.
Luis: I can be rollback owner and coordinate infra actions. No DB migrations, right?
Alex: No DB changes. Artifact: runtime-engine@v2.14. Quant config at s3://redwood-quant/q-lite-8.json.
Cheng: Proposed plan: 21:50 preflight (canary-check + quick-eval), 22:00 deploy 2 canary slabs, 22:10 observe 10m, 22:20 roll remaining slabs if green.
Marie: Smoke checklist (short): 1) /health endpoints green 2) 1k sample gen with long-context 3) KV cache hit rate sanity 4) tail latency p95 < 250ms 5) error rate < 0.5%
Alex: Add quality gate: run quick eval set 'summaries-core' — if quality drops >1.5% vs baseline, abort and rollback.
Cheng: I have scripts/quick-eval.sh --set=summaries-core ready. Will post eval delta after preflight.
Luis: Rollback plan: previous tag runtime-engine@v2.13 retained; rollback command is `inv rollback --to=2.13` (~5m per slab). I'll prepare a rollback runbook and contact list.
Marie: I'll watch logs for OOM, tokenization errors, and quant decoding errors. If we see >0.5% decoding errors or OOMs, call abort.
Cheng: Who can flip fallback routing if GPU slab issues appear? Need someone with console rights to set route policy to fallback.
Alex: Pinged @infra-ops to standby. Marie, you can also flip route priority in Console: set `route_priority: fallback` under service > routing.
Marie: Can do. I'll queue the route change as an action item and keep the change short. If I flip, I'll post the exact command and timestamp.
Cheng: Quick ask: can someone approve the canary slab claim? Deploy console link: https://deploy.console/review/12981
Alex: Approved. Cheng, go ahead with preflight at 21:50.
Luis: I'll be on standby 22:20–23:00 for rollback and infra ops.
Cheng: Starting preflight now. Posting condensed preflight output:
```
preflight: canary slice ok
latency p50: 78ms p95: 205ms
kv-cache-hit: 72%
eval delta: +0.2%
errors: 0.02%
```
Marie: Perf looks good. KV hit is slightly lower than baseline but within expected for q-lite-8. Proceed to canary. :thumbsup:
Cheng: Canary deploy kicked off. Will post canary metrics after 3 minutes.
Alex: Reminder: keep messages concise. If anyone hits abort criteria, shout "ABORT" and tag the channel; Marie or Luis will flip routing/rollback.
Cheng: Canary metrics after 3m:
- p95: 212ms (stable)
- error rate: 0.03%
- kv-hit: 71%
- eval delta: +0.1%
No anomalies. Proceeding to roll remainder in 5m.
Marie: Watching for memory growth. Nothing unusual in GC traces so far.
Luis: Infra checks look green. Rolling full. Standby for any rollback triggers.
Cheng: Full roll started. Posting final smoke once finished.
Alex: Thanks team. Short retrospective in morning about quant hit-rate impact and if we need further tuning.
Cheng: Full roll finished. Final smoke:
```
final: p95: 215ms
kv-hit: 70%
eval delta: +0.15%
errors: 0.03%
```
Marie: All checks pass per checklist. I'll keep a 1-hour watch, then clear the window.
Luis: Rollback artifacts ready but not needed. Closing standby.
Alex: Great run — please add any follow-ups to the deploy doc and ping infra-ops for any slab anomalies later.
